exposure: Implementation of standardized counseling on cesarean risk during labor induction
outcome: Birth satisfaction (total Birth Satisfaction Scale-Revised (BSS-R) score and satisfaction domains)
cohort: 1,008 women with full-term singleton gestations, intact membranes, and an unfavorable cervix undergoing induction
finding: Implementation of standardized counseling on cesarean risk during labor induction was associated with a decrease in racial disparities in birth satisfaction.
